verdict.rationale: The product is an AI agent that operates an iPhone to complete user-typed goals. Nothing in the evidence shows it producing AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the app. Run replay is a manual review feature, and trace export hands analysis to another agent outside the product, so neither counts as in-product AI insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
